name: VO2 verify trained 24
description: Verification bout after the trained ramp, 2-3 days later: 12.0 km/h level 6 to exhaustion (cap 4 min). See docs/treadmill/VO2MAX.md. Stop with the console STOP key at exhaustion. Needs --running-mode, handrail up.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy jog, mask on and fitted, breathing settles.

steps.name: Verification load
steps.notes: Hold to exhaustion; stop the belt when you cannot continue.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Walk it off; keep the mask on for the first minutes of recovery data.
